mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K, or HOUST's 3-month moving average fails to correlate with consumer confidence (p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or the joint labor market signal fails to correlate with GDP growth (p > 0.15)

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling supply chain resilience, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO > 6-month MA, or INDPRO's growth fails to correlate with capacity utilization (p > 0.12)

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating sluggish demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth < 2%, or GDPC1's growth fails to correlate with consumer spending (p > 0.18)

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3% over 6 months, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and rising inflation predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or the joint monetary and inflation signal fails to correlate with Treasury yield curve shifts (p > 0.2)

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month, signaling labor market stress, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5%, or UNRATE's surprises fail to correlate with subsequent market volatility (p > 0.25)

mechanism_narrative: A consistent growth in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average, indicating sustained consumer demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of holiday season instances when RSAFS growth is consistent, or RSAFS's holiday growth fails to correlate with subsequent quarterly GDP growth (p > 0.22)
